CROSS-APP CONTRACT: SEALED APP FILE MANIFEST AS DMG SIDECAR
============================================================
Date: 2026-11-07
Branch: fix/sealed-manifest-20261107
Base: 91c069b
Contract State: PROPOSED - PENDING GATEWAY AGREEMENT (NO PRODUCT CODE UNTIL ACK)

1. BACKGROUND & PROBLEM STATEMENT (PROVEN BY 0.6.224 PACKAGE-R3-BLOCKED.JSON)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
In Studio Hub release 0.6.224, app bundle manifest generation took place before
outer bundle code signing. macOS ad-hoc deep code signing (`codesign --force
--deep --sign -`) rewrites the native Mach-O executable header/signature slot
(`Contents/MacOS/StudioHub`) and writes `Contents/_CodeSignature/CodeResources`.
Consequently:
  - Generating the manifest BEFORE deep seal leaves stale native hashes and
    omits `CodeResources`.
  - Regenerating the manifest AFTER deep seal modifies files inside the sealed
    bundle (`Contents/Resources/file-manifest/index.json` and `*.tsv.gz`), causing
    `codesign --verify --deep --strict` to fail with exit 1 ("a sealed resource
    is missing or invalid").
  - The circular dependency cannot be resolved inside the bundle without either
    excluding native binaries / signatures (which breaks delta integrity) or
    moving the manifest outside the sealed bundle.

2. THE SMALLEST COMPLETE ARCHITECTURAL SOLUTION
-----------------------------------------------
The manifest is placed OUTSIDE the sealed `.app` bundle as a DMG SIDECAR:
  - Inside the DMG volume root:
      <dmg_mount_root>/Studio Hub.app/
      <dmg_mount_root>/file-manifest/
          index.json
          core.tsv.gz
          runtime-<name>.tsv.gz (if applicable)
  - `Studio Hub.app` contains NO `file-manifest/` directory inside `Contents/Resources/`.
  - Code signing executes `--force --deep --strict` on `Studio Hub.app` cleanly.
  - Manifest generation runs AFTER signing has completed, scanning the signed bundle.
  - Because `file-manifest/` is written outside the `.app`, the code signature of
    `Studio Hub.app` is untouched and `codesign --verify --deep --strict` exits 0.

3. SCHEMA & FIELD SPECIFICATION (UNCHANGED WIRE PROTOCOL)
---------------------------------------------------------
Schema identifier remains: "studiohub.file-manifest.v1"
No fields added, no fields removed, wire encoding identical.

A. index.json Schema:
{
  "schema": "studiohub.file-manifest.v1",
  "files_sha256": "<64-hex lowercase sha256>",
  "files_count": <integer>,
  "files_bytes": <integer>,
  "groups": {
    "<group_name>": {
      "sha256": "<64-hex uncompressed tsv sha256>",
      "files": <integer>,
      "bytes": <integer>,
      "prefix": "<path prefix or empty string>"
    }
  }
}

B. Group TSV Format (uncompressed, gzipped as <name>.tsv.gz with level 9, mtime=0):
Format per line:
  kind \t executable \t size \t sha256_or_symlink_target \t relpath \n
Sorted deterministically by utf-8 bytes of relpath.
  - kind: "f" (regular file) or "l" (symlink)
  - executable: "1" (owner-executable) or "0"
  - size: file size in bytes ("0" for symlink)
  - sha256: 64-hex digest of file bytes (or link target for "l")
  - relpath: path relative to app root (e.g. "Contents/MacOS/StudioHub")

4. COMPLETE FILE HASH & SIGNATURE CLOSURE
-----------------------------------------
The sidecar manifest lists 100% of the files in the sealed app:
  - `Contents/MacOS/StudioHub` is listed with its final post-seal Mach-O digest.
  - `Contents/_CodeSignature/CodeResources` is listed with its final digest.
  - `files_sha256` commits to every group TSV digest:
      SHA256( "".join(f"{name}\0{group_shas[name]}\n" for name in sorted(group_shas)) )
  - Descriptor and DMG whole hash guard the entire release artifact.
  - No signature or executable exclusions exist. Full integrity is preserved.

5. CONSUMER LOOKUP ORDER (GATEWAY & HUB)
----------------------------------------
When reading a file manifest from a mounted release disk image:
  Priority 1 (Preferred / Sealed Releases):
    <dmg_mount_root>/file-manifest/index.json
    <dmg_mount_root>/file-manifest/<group>.tsv.gz
  Priority 2 (Legacy Fallback / Pre-0.6.225 Releases):
    <dmg_mount_root>/Studio Hub.app/Contents/Resources/file-manifest/index.json
    <dmg_mount_root>/Studio Hub.app/Contents/Resources/file-manifest/<group>.tsv.gz
  Priority 3 (Refusal):
    If neither location contains `index.json`, raise `ReleaseError(400, "RELEASE_NO_MANIFEST")`.

6. UNTRUSTED 0.6.224 BASELINE REJECTION & WHOLE-DMG FALLBACK
------------------------------------------------------------
Why 0.6.224 Baseline is Untrusted:
  - In 0.6.224, `Contents/MacOS/StudioHub` on disk has post-seal digest `55f41363...`
    while its embedded manifest declared `b282910d...`.
  - In 0.6.224, `Contents/_CodeSignature/CodeResources` exists on disk but is unlisted
    in the embedded manifest.
  - A node running 0.6.224 therefore possesses a corrupted/stale baseline.

Hub Baseline Evaluation:
  - Hub checks its installed app against its installed manifest.
  - If native executable digest mismatches or code signature resources are unlisted,
    the baseline is classified as `UNTRUSTED_BASELINE`.

Wire Protocol & Gateway Resolution (No New Routes, Uses Existing Semantics):
  - In `GET /api/hub/release`, a Hub running with an untrusted baseline publishes:
      "delta": null
  - Gateway's `_probe(base, token)` checks:
      capable = isinstance(delta, dict) and delta.get("schema") == MANIFEST_SCHEMA
    Since `delta` is null, `capable` evaluates to `False`.
  - Gateway's `publish()` calculates:
      planned = "full" if force_full or not (capable and manifest and delta_descriptor) else "delta"
    Because `capable` is `False`, `planned` is "full".
  - Gateway executes `push(url, token, descriptor, dmg_path)` sending the whole DMG.
  - Boundary: Gateway `push_delta` whole-image fallback only triggers on missing 404/405
    or absent capability (other responses are final refusals). Emitting `delta: null`
    cleanly triggers whole-DMG installation before `push_delta` is ever invoked.

7. COMPATIBILITY WITH OLD CLIENTS
---------------------------------
  - Older Hub nodes receiving a full DMG install `Studio Hub.app` directly from DMG root.
  - Gateway updated with Priority 1 sidecar lookup transparently supports new releases
    while retaining Priority 2 legacy embedded lookup for older DMGs.
  - Older Gateway instances that don't know the sidecar location find no embedded manifest
    and cleanly fall back to whole-DMG push (`planned = "full"`), avoiding corrupt deltas.

8. AFFECTED FILES (POST-AGREEMENT IMPLEMENTATION PLAN)
------------------------------------------------------
Hub Repository (Current worktree: fix/sealed-manifest-20261107):
  1. `packaging/stage_voice.py`:
     - Stage app bundle without `Contents/Resources/file-manifest`.
     - Execute deep ad-hoc code sign on `Studio Hub.app`.
     - Write manifest into DMG staging root under `file-manifest/`.
  2. `packaging/make_dmg.py`:
     - Include `file-manifest/` sidecar beside `Studio Hub.app` in DMG creation.
  3. `components/hub/backend/file_manifest.py`:
     - Update `walk()` to reflect that manifest directory is outside `.app`.
  4. `components/hub/backend/release_delta.py`:
     - Add baseline trust validator detecting native/signature mismatch.
     - Support sidecar directory in `installed_manifest()`.
  5. `components/hub/standalone.py`:
     - In `GET /api/hub/release`, omit `delta` capability if installed baseline is untrusted.

Gateway Repository (For Gateway team implementation):
  1. `gateway/release_publisher.py`:
     - In `load_manifest(root: Path)`, implement Priority 1 sidecar lookup:
       check `root / "file-manifest"` before `app / "Contents/Resources/file-manifest"`.
